research_notes: The later operating policy can use the smallest-safe-unit concept to avoid starting a long task near hard cap.
This is compatible with both fixed soft cutoff and estimated-next-task admission.
The policy should checkpoint before authority transfer rather than relying on successor reconstruction from conversational context.
Durable state remains the correct handoff substrate for disposable invocations.
The current runtime study is therefore directly informing the later relay control policy, not merely measuring a timeout.
Parallelism remains an orthogonal throughput enhancement to revisit after this control envelope is known.
